reason: Under SEC08-BP04 Implementation guidance the quote says you can separate data of different classification levels with distinct AWS accounts per level managed by AWS Organizations, and that this isolation minimizes the risk of data exposure; the claim frames it as guidance, matching the page.

The quote supports only that a public website needs all content publicly readable to be reached at the website endpoint; the added clause that the website endpoint supports only publicly readable content is not in the quote or its context.

The quote states S3 website endpoints do not support HTTPS or access points, and the context lists Use Amazon CloudFront to serve a static website hosted on S3 among the options under If you want to use HTTPS.
The quote states a bucket configured as a static website is available at the AWS Region-specific website endpoint of the bucket and that website endpoints are different from REST API endpoints.
The quote states verbatim that Requester Pays buckets do not allow access through a website endpoint and any such request receives 403 Access Denied.
The quotes state that an SSE-KMS encrypted website bucket needs a CloudFront distribution because SSE-KMS doesn't support anonymous users, and that OAI doesn't support SSE-KMS so OAC must be used.
